searchPhrase: hotels with pool London / London hotels with swimming pool. Bing's SERP for 'hotels with pool London' (29 Sep 2026) is booking engines (Booking.com, Tripadvisor, lastminute, Hotels.com), brand pages (Marriott, IHG) and three editorial lists: The Hotel Guru, The Telegraph and Luxury Travel Diary.

scope.whatCounts: A pool a hotel guest can swim in: a lap or leisure pool the hotel publishes as its own, or a health club pool the hotel says its guests use free. Vitality, hydrotherapy and relaxation pools on their own do not count and are named as such.
scope.central: Central London only, each with its nearest station. Canary Wharf, Battersea Power Station and Bethnal Green are in, because each sits on a Tube line a short ride from the centre. InterContinental O2 and Aloft ExCeL are further out and were set aside - see excluded.
scope.groups: Rooftop and sky-high pools (seasonal ones flagged); pools that welcome children, with the hours; spa pools, mostly for adults; good-value hotels with a pool (Rob's grouping; the chain four-stars and Town Hall, prices still needed to back the label).
scope.pricing: Only the sheet's typicalFrom values are printed (src/data/hotels.json). No rates were scraped. Hotels without a sheet price carry none - listed for Rob in pricesNeeded.

knownGaps: Reddit is blocked to curl in this environment (403 on www, old and .json), so tier E rests on one Mumsnet Talk thread. r/FATTravel 'London hotels with inside pools' (1i3fhmy) and r/TravelHacks 1ajjkx4 surfaced in the SERP and are worth recording by hand.
Brave returned 429 and DuckDuckGo a 202 bot challenge for the whole pass; Bing HTML answered one query and then degraded to first-word matching. Yahoo (Bing-backed) via curl carried the SERP work.
The Telegraph's pool list (2nd or 3rd on every SERP) returns 402 to bots, and The Glossary and The Handbook returned a Cloudflare challenge - none read.

Operator sites for Hilton (hilton.com), Marriott (marriott.com: Park Lane, Aloft ExCeL), Hyatt and Town Hall's own home page block curl; Town Hall's /facilities page did load. Hilton London Bankside (5 sources) and London Marriott Hotel Park Lane (3) are out of the article only because their pool rules could not be read from the operator.

Shoreditch House (11 sources) and White City House (7) are Soho House members' clubs with bookable bedrooms; Soho House's pages do not say whether a non-member staying the night can use the rooftop pool. Out until Rob confirms.

InterContinental London - The O2 (3 sources): IHG's page gives the pool's hours and children's times but not whether hotel guests pay; Head for Points reported a £30-an-hour pool fee in April 2022. Out until the fee is confirmed.

notASwimmingPool.name: Corinthia London
notASwimmingPool.what: Biome by Corinthia's thermal floor lists two vitality pools and a hydrotherapy pool, and no lap pool. Family swimming 8-10am and 4-5pm for residents.

notASwimmingPool.name: St Pancras London, Autograph Collection
notASwimmingPool.what: The spa in the old steam kitchens has a relaxation pool with hydro loungers - described by the hotel as a hydrotherapy pool.

notASwimmingPool.name: The Landmark London
notASwimmingPool.what: The relaunched spa lists a vitality pool (Finnish sauna, steam room, vitality pool, 24-hour gym, five treatment rooms), children's hours 9-11am and 3-5pm, spa 7am-9.30pm. where-to-stay-marylebone.md already calls it a vitality pool heated to 34C. best-family-hotels-london.md said '15-metre chlorine-free pool' (from Mumsnet) and was corrected in the same commit as this guide.
